text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Experiment 581's injected bank: a constant shift of 15%, 30%, or 50% of capacity, lasting 3, 7, or 15 days, added to the history power of every Primary at once. Forecasts 24 to 120 h ahead, from day 4 of the shift to its end; five fold months; one estimate per bar, no interval. Dashed line: the nominal 0.95. K3-pre reads no power, so it follows 0.'
text.tspan: Experiment 581's injected bank: a constant shift of 15%, 30%, or 50% of capacity, lasting 3, 7, or 15 days, added to the
history power of every Primary at once. Forecasts 24 to 120 h ahead, from day 4 of the shift to its end; five fold months;
one estimate per bar, no interval. Dashed line: the nominal 0.95. K3-pre reads no power, so it follows 0.
